questions.question: Moses told Israel that the LORD had said Moses would lead them across the Jordan River. True or false?
Before Moses died, which man did Moses say would cross the Jordan ahead of Israel, as the LORD had said?
Moses told Israel to be strong and not afraid of the nations in the land. What reason did he give?

answers.text: The LORD their God goes with them
Joshua has never lost a battle
The nations are already running away

questions.question: Before Moses died, what did the LORD say Israel would do in the land they were entering?

answers.text: Turn to foreign gods and break His covenant
Stay faithful to Him for good
Refuse to go in and turn back
